title: Best TV deal: Save $900 on Toshiba 65-Inch G700 Series ArtVision
excerpt: Early October Prime Day deals are sure looking good.
content_html:
SAVE $900: As of Sept. 24, the Toshiba 65-inch G700 Series ArtVision 4K TV is on sale for $1,099.99 at Amazon. That's $900 off its full price of $1,999.99.

Credit: Toshiba

$1,099.99 at Amazon
$1,999.99 Save $900

Bargain hunters know that there are few greater pleasures than a big deal on a big TV. There's a reason that Black Friday used to be a stampede of shoppers towards the TV aisle. Thankfully, the next major sale event is almost here: October Prime Day runs from Oct. 6-7, and there are already some early deals live on Amazon.

As far as we're concerned, the bigger the better for both the TV and the discount. In that respect, the Toshiba 65-inch G700 Series ArtVision 4K TV hits the right spot — a whopper TV with a 45% markdown.

As of Sept. 24, the Toshiba 65-inch G700 Series ArtVision 4K TV is available on Amazon for $1,099.99, representing an incredible $900 saving on the usual price of $1,999.99.

This TV is part of a very modern range that looks like a portrait, mounts on the wall, and enhances the room's overall aesthetic when it's not being watched. You can even set it to display a variety of artwork or images via Art Gallery Mode to keep the room's decor varied. It's just as impressive as an actual TV, delivering 4K courtesy of a QLED display.
